page.overview:
Who is Dr. Henry Wu?

Masrani Global Corporation (Formerly; 2000's-2015) Eli Mills's operation (Formerly; 2015-2018) Biosyn (Formerly; 2018-2022)}}

Dr. Henry Wu is the lead geneticist who worked for InGen and later Biosyn.

He is the secondary antagonist turned redeemed anti-hero of the Jurassic Park franchise, the chief genetic engineer of InGen and the that recreates the dinosaurs in all Jurassic Park media. He is a major character in the book, but in the film, he is only a minor character with the majority of his role being taken over by Mr. DNA.

He serves as a minor character of , the secondary antagonist of Jurassic World, tertiary antagonist of , a major antagonist of the Netflix spin-off Jurassic World: Camp Cretaceous, and a redeemed anti-hero of and Jurassic World: Chaos Theory. In Camp Cretaceous, he serves as a major antagonist of Season 1, one of the two unseen overarching antagonists of Season 2, an unseen antagonist of Seasons 4 and 5, and an anti-hero near the end of Season 3. He is also a redeemed anti-hero in Season 4 of Chaos Theory.

Also known as: Dr. Wu, Wu.
